SELECT A.COMPANY, A.DOCU_NO, A.DOCU_TITLE, NVL(A.DOCU_CONT,' ') AS DOCU_CONT, A.USER_ID, A.USER_NM, TO_CHAR(A.START_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS APP_DATE, GET_CSTMR_DEAL_STTMN_NO(A.COMPANY) AS APPR_ID, A.IMAGE_KEY, B.KEY_1 AS GW_NO, (SELECT TEXT4 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND TEXT1 = A.COMPANY) AS COMPANYID FROM ICOGDOCU A, ICOMTRGW B WHERE A.COMPANY IN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002') AND A.EXTIF_TP = 'NS' AND A.PASS_STATUS = '0'
AND A.COMPANY = B.COM_CODE AND A.DOCU_NO = B.TARGET
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND C WHERE C.BUYER = A.COMPANY AND C.DOC_NO = A.DOCU_NO )

SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER , B.COM_NAME_LOC FROM KEPRQDT A, ICOMCMPY B WHERE A.BUYER IN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002') AND A.GW_NO = #GW_NO# AND A.RECV_FLAG = 'GS'
AND B.COM_CODE = A.BUYER ORDER BY BUYER

SELECT A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION, NVL(A.DESCRIPTION,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(A.SPECIFICATION, ' ') AS SPECIFICATION, NVL(TRIM(TO_CHAR(A.ITEM_QTY,'999,999,999,999,999')),'1') AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(A.MAKER_PART_NO,' ') AS MAKER_PART_NO, NVL(A.MAKER_NAME,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, NVL(A.UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, TRIM(TO_CHAR(NVL(A.MOQ_QTY, 1),'999,999,999,999,999')) AS MOQ_QTY, NVL(B.BID_SUCCESS_REASON,' ') AS BID_SUCCESS_REASON
FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.GW_NO = #GW_NO# AND A.RECV_FLAG = 'GS'
AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION = A.REVISION AND B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y'
ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ

SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(SUM(B.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE * NVL(A.ITEM_QTY, 1)),'999,999,999,999,999')) AS SUM_PRICE FROM KEPRQDT A, KEPQTDT B WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.GW_NO = #GW_NO# AND A.RECV_FLAG = 'GS'
AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION = A.REVISION AND B.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG = 'Y'

SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE,'999,999,999,999,999')) AS ATOB_UNIT_PRICE , TRIM(TO_CHAR(A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE * NVL(B.ITEM_QTY, 1),'999,999,999,999,999')) AS ATOB_UNIT_PRICE_SUM FROM KEPQTDT A, KEPRQDT B WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.QUOTATION_NO = #QUOTATION_NO# AND A.QUOTATION_SEQ = #QUOTATION_SEQ# AND A.REVISION = #REVISION#
AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND B.QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND B.REVISION = A.REVISION
AND ROWNUM <= 3 ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION, A.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG DESC, A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE

SELECT DOC_NO ,DOC_SEQ ,TYPE ,DES_FILE_NAME ,SRC_FILE_NAME ,FILE_SIZE / 1000 FILE_SIZE ,ADD_DATE ,ADD_TIME ,CHANGE_DATE ,CHANGE_TIME ,ADD_USER_ID ,ADD_USER_NAME ,DES_FILE_DIR FROM ICOMATCH WHERE DOC_NO = #IMAGE_KEY#
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO EAI.IF_APL_SEND ( BUYER, DOC_NO, APP_SEQ, USER_ID, USER_NAME, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3, KEY_4, KEY_5, KEY_6, KEY_7, KEY_8, KEY_9, KEY_10 ) SELECT A.COMPANY, A.DOCU_NO, A.ORDER_NO, (SELECT NVL(LEGACY_USER_ID,A.USER_ID) FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = #COMPANY# AND USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS USER_ID, A.USER_NM, #APPR_ID# AS KEY_1, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(A.PASS_TP) = '2' THEN '9' WHEN TO_CHAR(A.PASS_TP) = '3' THEN '2' ELSE TO_CHAR(A.PASS_TP) END AS KEY_2 , '' AS KEY_3, '' AS KEY_4, '' AS KEY_5, '' AS KEY_6, '' AS KEY_7, '' AS KEY_8, '' AS KEY_9, '' AS KEY_10 FROM ICOGPASSLN A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.COMPANY = #COMPANY# AND A.DOCU_NO = #DOCU_NO#

INSERT INTO EAI.IF_APM_SEND ( BUYER, DOC_NO, SUBJECT, CONTENTS, APP_USER_ID, APP_USER_NAME, APP_DATE, KEY_1, KEP_2, KEP_3, KEP_4, KEY_5, KEY_6, KEY_7, KEY_8, KEY_9, KEY_10, CREATE_DATM, IF_FLAG ) VALUES ( #COMPANY#, #DOCU_NO#, #DOCU_TITLE#, #CONTENTS:CLOB#, #USER_ID#, #USER_NM#, #APP_DATE#, #APPR_ID#, 'MROHW8914', 'NEGO', #GW_GA_NO#, '', '', '', '', '', '', SYSDATE, 'N' )
sqlMap.select:
SELECT A.BUYER, A.DOC_NO, KEY_1 AS APPRID, B.LEGACY_USER_ID, A.SUBJECT, A.CONTENTS, TO_CHAR(C.START_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS ADD_DATE, KEP_2 AS SYSTEMID, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN ('KRHANW0100') THEN ( SELECT MAX(CD2.TEXT4) FROM ICOMCOD2 CD1, ICOMCOD2 CD2 WHERE CD1.TYPE = 'C001' AND CD1.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CD1.CODE = B.DEPARTMENT AND CD2.TYPE = 'PLNT' AND CD2.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND CD2.CODE = CD1.TEXT5 ) ELSE (SELECT MAX(TEXT4) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND TEXT1 = A.BUYER) END AS COMPANYID, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN ('KRHANW0100') THEN (SELECT TEXT3 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CODE = B.DEPARTMENT) ELSE (SELECT MAX(TEXT3) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND TEXT1 = A.BUYER) END AS FORMCODE FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND A , ICOMLUSR B , ICOGDOCU C WHERE A.BUYER = #COMPANY# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOCU_NO# AND A.KEY_9 IS NULL AND A.KEY_1 IS NOT NULL AND A.CREATE_DATM > TRUNC(SYSDATE - 60) AND A.IF_FLAG = 'N'
AND B.USER_ID = A.APP_USER_ID
AND C.COMPANY = A.BUYER AND C.DOCU_NO = A.DOC_NO AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT A.KEY_1 AS APPRID, TO_CHAR(A.APP_SEQ - 1) AS APPRSEQ, TO_CHAR(A.KEY_2) AS APPRACTIONCD, NVL(C.LEGACY_USER_ID,A.USER_ID) AS USER_ID FROM EAI.IF_APL_SEND A , ICOGPASSLN B , ICOMLUSR C WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOC_NO# AND A.APP_SEQ = B.ORDER_NO AND A.KEY_2 != '9'
AND B.COMPANY = A.BUYER AND B.DOCU_NO = A.DOC_NO AND B.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND LEGACY_USER_ID = A.USER_ID)
AND C.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND C.LEGACY_USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND C.USER_ID = B.USER_ID

SELECT A.KEY_1 AS APPRID, TO_CHAR(A.APP_SEQ - 1) AS APPRSEQ, TO_CHAR(A.KEY_2) AS APPRACTIONCD, NVL(C.LEGACY_USER_ID,A.USER_ID) AS USER_ID FROM EAI.IF_APL_SEND A , ICOGPASSLN B , ICOMLUSR C WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOC_NO# AND A.APP_SEQ = B.ORDER_NO AND A.KEY_2 = '9'
AND B.COMPANY = A.BUYER AND B.DOCU_NO = A.DOC_NO AND B.USER_ID IN (SELECT USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND LEGACY_USER_ID = A.USER_ID)
AND C.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND C.LEGACY_USER_ID = A.USER_ID AND C.USER_ID = B.USER_ID
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_APM_SEND A SET KEY_7 = #RTN_MSG# , IF_FLAG = #RTN_FLAG# , IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.DOC_NO = #DOC_NO#
